indicator_definition: Population-weighted mean annual exposure to fine particulate matter (PM2.5) in micrograms per cubic metre. PM2.5 causes respiratory and cardiovascular disease. Data compiled by the EEA from air quality monitoring networks.
rationale: Air pollution is the leading environmental cause of premature death in Europe. Progress means a sustained reduction in population-weighted PM2.5 exposure.
methodology_characteristics: Compiled by the EEA from national monitoring networks under the Ambient Air Quality Directive. Population-weighted using modelled concentrations and population density. Published annually.
indicator_name: Population exposure to air pollution by PM2.5
graph_title: Population exposure to air pollution by PM2.5
